main_subject.description: An adult East Asian woman with loosely tied-back dark hair, soft natural strands, minimal makeup, and a thoughtful distant gaze.
main_subject.wardrobe: A black wool coat and dark charcoal scarf with no visible branding.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Side-profile close portrait, standing outdoors and looking toward the horizon.

composition_elements.setting: Open abstract landscape at sunset with a smooth warm-orange to muted-teal sky gradient.
composition_elements.framing: 85mm close profile with subject sharp and landscape gently blurred.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No logos, text, watermark, or celebrity likeness.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft golden-hour side light on one half of the face, with gentle background falloff.

technical_specs.rendering: Natural skin, soft bokeh, subtle grain, restrained dynamic range, realistic hair strands.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical 85mm cinematic film profile portrait of an adult East Asian woman with loosely tied-back dark hair, soft natural strands, minimal makeup, and a thoughtful distant gaze. She wears a black wool coat and dark charcoal scarf. Capture her standing outdoors in side-profile, looking toward a softly blurred open landscape at sunset. Use warm golden-hour side light on one half of her face, a smooth warm-orange to muted-teal sky gradient, natural skin, soft bokeh, subtle grain, restrained dynamic range, and realistic hair strands. No logo, readable text, watermark, celebrity likeness, or sexualized styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, HDR, logo, readable text, watermark, plastic skin, distorted profile, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Any optional identity reference must depict a consenting adult. Wardrobe and landscape references are replaceable and must contain no text or branding.
